Superimposed on the scene is a white rounded rectangle containing text related to “LaMDA Metrics” including “Human-generated fine-tuning of the model.” The text elaborates that LaMDA uses a metric based on “Sense, Specificity, and Interest,” referred to as "SSI", which is generated by crowd-sourced human evaluators. It is compared to an automated metric used in neural networks called "Perplexity-like" which involves how many correlated options the model has to choose from for the next sequence in the dialogue. An example of "what to watch", with two correlated answers shows the perplexity of the sequence dialogue. As the narration continues, more text appears on the rectangle, providing detailed descriptions of the SSI metric. There are no people visible in the video.
